documents.text: 9 ] Career [ edit ] Recording career [ edit ] Deodato often plays the Fender Rhodes electric piano . He became successful as a keyboard player in the 1970s . Since then , he has produced and arranged music on more than 500 albums for artists such as Kool & the Gang , Con Funk Shun , Björk , Christophe , Ithamara Koorax and k.d . lang . Guitarist John Tropea and flautist Hubert Laws appeared on his early albums . Prelude , his first album in the U.S. , was released in 1973 . [ 10 ] His
